blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Gel Cayuna relished her stronger connection with Brooke Van Sickle and the Nxled Chameleons as they delivered the franchise’s first win against Creamline to stay unbeaten in the 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series. Cayuna dished out 20 excellent sets as Nxled secured the No.1 seed and twice-to-beat bonus in the semifinals after beating Creamline, 25-20, 12-25, 25-21, 25-19, on Tuesday night at Philsports Arena. The five-time PVL Conference Best Setter was grateful to provide significant contributions for the new team, which beat the 11-time champion for the first time after nine games since joining the league in […]...
